text:
incident-bot: Paging @sre-oncall — Saratoga Financial (VPC: saratoga-prod) is reporting sustained 429s from their dedicated pool for the past 6 minutes. Alert: high 429 rate (p50 120ms, 429 spike 18%) :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: I have the page, joining. Can someone drop a quick customer impact summary?

alex: Customer's prod endpoint /v1/generate is getting 18% 429s, primarily during their nightly reconciliation job. They say user-facing latency is up but not fully down yet.

emily-cs: Confirmed with Saratoga: risk of failed settlement runs if not mitigated for next 30m. They're on an enterprise contract with reserved capacity but the job bursts past their reserved limits.

maria: Jumping in — looking at runtime metrics now. I see per-tenant quota exhaustion and fairshare kicking in. KV-cache miss rate for that tenant jumped 10x after job started.

cheng: Past 5 min logs show repeated token_bucket rejections: "quota_exceeded: tenant_quota=enterprise_burst, allowance=0". Also a bunch of 503s downstream from the burst queue.

sre-oncall: Root ask: keep customer tasks running for next 60m. Options: emergency temporary lift, reroute their traffic to spare dedicated nodes, or throttle internal non-critical jobs. What's fastest?

emily-cs: Customer prefers an emergency lift if possible — they have a contract clause for short bursts but need manual approval from billing/sales.

sales-liaison: I can approve up to 2x burst for 30m under their contract. For anything longer we need ops-legal signoff.

maria: Technically fastest is to open a temporary quota override (contract override tag: enterprise-burst) and shift their traffic to the spare dedicated pool in us-west2. I can trigger reroute + lift in ~2-3 minutes once approved.

ops-legal: Noted — need an email trail post-fact. Approve emergency lift for 30m for mitigation; escalate if extension requested.

cheng: Action plan: 1) sales-liaison confirm approval. 2) ops creates temporary quota override token. 3) maria executes reroute to spare dedicated nodes and enables lax token_bucket window. 4) monitor 429 rate and KV-cache warm. 5) rollback after 30m and validate job success.

sales-liaison: Confirmed approval for 30m emergency lift now. Proceed.

maria: Running command to create override: ```sh 
# create temporary override tag for tenant saratoga-prod
redwoodctl overrides create --tenant saratoga-prod --scope quota --tag enterprise-burst --duration 30m --notes "Emergency 30m lift for nightly reconciliation"
```

deploy-bot: override/enterprise-burst created by maria at 2026-03-15T14:07:12Z (expires in 30m). ID: ov-7a9c

maria: Now initiating traffic re-route to spare pool (us-west2-dedicated-spare). Command: ```sh
redwoodctl route set --tenant saratoga-prod --target dedicated:us-west2-dedicated-spare --strategy drain --timeout 60s
```

deploy-bot: route change requested by maria — starting graceful drain from current pool. Estimated shift 75s.

cheng: KV-cache warmups triggered: prefetching top prefixes for saratoga-prod. Should reduce misses.

alex: Monitoring dashboards — 429s dropping: now 6% after re-route, latency back to baseline for user-facing endpoints. Nightly job still in flight; reconciliation progress appears to continue.

emily-cs: Customer says job resumed and partial settlements processed. They asked about avoiding recurrence — can we propose a long-term fix?

sre-oncall: For postmortem we need: root cause (job burst pattern + cache cold start), whether autoscale / fairshare thresholds need tuning, and if dedicated pool sizing was insufficient. Also check alerts for quota headroom.

maria: I'll capture the exact commands and metrics to the incident ticket. Suggest we add a rule to detect scheduled heavy jobs and pre-warm KV cache or schedule brief pre-burst lifts via scheduled overrides.

ops-legal: Reminder: please attach customer's written acknowledgement (sales can follow up). We logged the approval here.

sales-liaison: I'll email the customer summary + ask for permission to include this incident in their billing adjustments if necessary.

cheng: Current status: 429 rate steady at 2.1%, override expires in 18m. I recommend we keep monitoring and prepare rollback in 12m to validate job still completes.

sre-oncall: Good. I'll stay on this until override expiry and then coordinate rollback. If 429s resurge after rollback, we escalate to capacity team for adding permanent headroom.

alex: Postmortem checklist created: incident-packet/saratoga-prod-3210123456.md with links to graphs, logs, and commands.

incident-bot: Reminder: oncall handoff in 45m. @sre-oncall — mark for handoff if still active.

emily-cs: Customer very appreciative. Closing the loop with them now.

sre-oncall: Thanks all — monitoring. Will update on rollback or if extension needed. :thumbsup:
